name: lesson-plan-authoring-skill
description: Markdown-first contract for authoring and revising university course lesson plans: canonical Markdown source, Word as compiled presentation, content QA before visual QA.

interface.shortDescription: Markdown-first contract for lesson-plan authoring and revision.
interface.longDescription: Govern university lesson-plan authoring and revision with a Markdown-first single-source model: canonical Markdown is the content authority, Word is a compiled presentation artifact; content QA precedes Word compilation; Word-to-Markdown reverse authoring is prohibited except one-time legacy migration.
capabilities: Define the Markdown-first authoring discipline for lesson plans
Contract knowledge maps, lesson records, deliverable bundles and visual QA
Provide regression scenarios and an executable contract check
defaultPrompt: Author a course lesson plan following the Markdown-first contract.
Check whether this lesson-plan revision preserves the calibrated baseline.
